CommitDate: Tue May 26 12:54:25 2026 +0300

    Bug 2039586 - Part 2: Rename xpcom_async into xpcom_async_glue. r=edicharry
    
    
    The main reason I've made this change is because I was told some time ago the
    name of this crate was confusing when coming to the outside, and meant the crate
    could be confused with an async runtime.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D300602
